FN-1N5AZLZ-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 64
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator Steve Livingston
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 64 as introduced could increase receipts to the enforcing law enforcement agency
from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general
funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of
the State General Fund, district attorneys, and local jails by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and
the penalties imposed. In addition, this could increase the administrative obligations of the
Department of Conservation and Natural Resources to adopt rules to implement and administer
the provisions of this bill.
Page 1
